name: The Manny
description: A busy executive hires a rancher to care for her kids in a moment of panic. Little does she know he'll challenge her views of gender roles — and of love.

videos.title: Yes, You Can Change the World
videos.overview: In a single day, Gabriel leaves a lasting impression on Jimena’s kids — and they, in turn, leave a lasting impression on a group of executives.

videos.title: The Tooth Fairy
videos.overview: The race for the company's presidency is on. As Gabriel continues to pull tricks up his sleeve, Jimena works up the courage to stand up for herself.

videos.title: The Value of a Like
videos.overview: An accidental swipe leads to a surprising twist in Jimena's evening, bringing about a serendipitous encounter with the right person.

videos.title: Cockfight
videos.overview: Just as Jimena ponders her next move, someone from her past shakes everything up, adding smiles — and tension — to her household.

videos.title: Wolves, Sheep, Pigs and Magicians
videos.overview: Jimena and her appointed accomplices set out to hunt information with the help of magic. But too much magic proves dismal for Gabriel's chances.

videos.title: Stolen Triumphs
videos.overview: A day at the country club becomes an opportunity for the kids to go after their true wishes and opens Jimena’s eyes to what she no longer wants.

videos.title: Twisted Arm
videos.overview: Ernesto and Sofía concoct a plan to bring a couple together while Jimena plots to bring them apart. Rogelio’s intentions come to light.

videos.title: What's Meant for You Won't Pass You By
videos.overview: The story around the ranches' payments becomes murkier. The kids ramp up the mischief as they vow to stop what they believe could be a dire outcome.

videos.title: Wrangled
videos.overview: Gabriel joins Leo on his school trip to the cattle show, where he realizes he risks revealing his identity — and, to Jimena’s dismay, his new romance.

videos.title: Changing the World
videos.overview: Jimena heads for Tepatitlán to gather more information, but just as things begin to look up, her hopes of getting what she wants are derailed.

videos.title: Pinwheel
videos.overview: After time apart, Gabriel and Jimena meet again, but a new face sparks his suspicion. Jimena receives a surprise proposal as her kids adjust.

videos.title: Lose Yourself to Find Yourself
videos.overview: As Gabriel's doubts about Matías rise, Matías delivers information on Jimena to a familiar figure. Sofía and Jimena deal with their own rivals.

videos.title: A Storm's Brewing
videos.overview: An accident in the woods brings Jimena and Gabriel closer as Matías questions Gabriel's intentions. Sofía's competitive nature takes center stage.

videos.title: Shooting Stars
videos.overview: Jimena and Gabriel agree to keep their secret from her kids, while Matías begins wedding preparations. Leo gets over his fear.

videos.title: I Don't Like Surprises
videos.overview: Jimena's meeting with a shady client raises her doubts about Matías. Joaquín gives his kids life-changing news. Gabriel and Violeta get closer.

videos.title: Skeletons in the Closet
videos.overview: Jimena faces the repercussions of her engagement party. Sofía is privy to a secret Claudia's been hiding. Rogelio's frustration with Matías mounts.

videos.title: Metamorphosis
videos.overview: Attempting to help Abel woo Sofía, Gabriel catches Jimena's attention. Santi's band makes a deal. A shocking business move leaves Jimena in a lurch.

videos.title: Spiderwebs
videos.overview: Jimena and Gabriel discover Matías' betrayal. Santi prepares for a big audition. A phone call puts everything Jimena has worked for at risk.

videos.title: Escaramuza
videos.overview: A year into their relationship, Jimena and Gabriel are juggling love and family, as Sofía struggles to adapt to new surroundings. Violeta returns.

videos.title: The Billboard
videos.overview: A diaper change changes Gabriel's life – and Jimena's. A billboard causes problems for Jimena, while Sofía struggles to regain her position at school.

videos.title: The Spark
videos.overview: Jimena sets out to reclaim her career, but it all goes awry. Violeta takes business into her own hands. A school vote tests Sofía's friendships.

videos.title: Fierce
videos.overview: Melissa's relentless campaign against Jimena forces her to play dirty. Santi and Claudia get their first heartbreaks.

videos.title: Love Can't Conquer All
videos.overview: Brenda's resignation forces Jimena to make a difficult decision about her business and Gabriel. Sofía and Claudia's relationship takes a turn.

videos.title: Words Are Just That
videos.overview: Sofía and Claudia take a break. Melissa's latest scoop tears Gabriel and Jimena even further apart. Brenda and Jimena make amends.

videos.title: Sleepless Nights
videos.overview: Gabriel and Violeta work to regain investors. Melissa reveals the reason for her grudge against Jimena. Sofía confesses her feelings for Claudia.

videos.title: Building Bridges
videos.overview: Sofía and Claudia go public with their relationship. An investigation into Fernández proves fruitful for Jimena and Gabriel in more ways than one.
